name: com.zr.list
description: Recycled uGUI lists, expandable groups and trees, nested horizontal and vertical lists, heterogeneous item prefabs and virtual grids with animated navigation.

samples.description: Fourteen ready-to-play list, expandable group and tree with Adapter and OnItemRender examples, business sorting, curved scroll, nested list, inventory, item drag, row-based and direct-cell reward reveal, and chat scenes with editable prefabs and a scene builder.
